name: Cross-Source Merge
description: Merges movies and series from several source folders into one library tree using symbolic links.
overview: Several source folders, one library: the plugin reads the sources, groups them by TMDB id, title and year and creates one folder per title holding one link per source.

versions.changelog: First public alpha, restarting the version line at 0.0.1. Movies and series from several source folders are merged into one library tree using symbolic links; sources are tagged (1 Local, 2 Stream, 3 NAS) and duplicates of the same source are numbered. Categories are their own libraries, missing sources stay visible as a shadow library with placeholders, orphaned targets can be cleaned up. User interface and documentation are in English.
